name: openvideo-downloader
description: Open-source Manifest V3 media sniffer and downloader for progressive, HLS and MPEG-DASH streams.
//: Intentionally dependency-free. The extension is loaded unpacked exactly as it sits in git: no bundler, no transpiler, no node_modules. Everything the download engine needs is vendored in src/vendor/. This file exists only to declare metadata and ES module semantics for editors and linters.

scripts.icons: echo 'Open tools/make-icons.html in Chrome - it writes the four PNGs into your Downloads folder.'
